decisions.reason: As a newly launched supplement range with its own page and a close fit to the firm's stated consumer-health portfolio expansion, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
The dedicated page and explicit launch message signal visible commitment, and because it extends the established consumer-health offer the firm would be inclined to persist for at least another year.
Although it was presented less prominently than A and B, it still supports the portfolio-broadening strategy and is recent enough that weak early results can be treated as temporary.
This more niche immune supplement has weaker visible commitment and could be easier to cut, but the firm's expansionary stance and tendency to justify recent launches still favor keeping it for now.

Despite the 2018 valsartan-related problem, the regulatory and manufacturing investment in a generic medicine is substantial and management can plausibly view the setback as temporary, so it is more likely to persist than withdraw.
